verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions connecting a Google or Outlook calendar, and never mentions per-meeting-type auto-capture rules. The closest items are adjacent: organization-wide recording policies and users manually choosing when to record or pause. Neither shows calendar-driven, per-meeting-type capture rules, and the webhooks scope note confirms no in-product rules engine is documented.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically
